entries.title: Whole names in the 2×2
entries.detail: In the efficiency and maturity chart, every bubble carries its whole name: ID ISG D-BAUG for an ID ISG, ISG D-BSSE for a departmental one.

entries.title: Docs opens the pactum Field Manual
entries.detail: About pactum › Docs and Settings › About pactum › Docs open the Field Manual: what pactum is, and the maturity rubric with its five levels for each of the nine dimensions. In the Mac app it opens in a window of its own, also without the internet.

entries.title: Not rated has its own strip
entries.detail: In the efficiency and maturity chart, an ISG without a maturity no longer sits at level 3 as if rated. It stands in a strip "Not rated" under the chart, at its efficiency.

entries.title: A calmer table, and a checked complexity factor
entries.detail: The KPI table shows its standing in calm greys with soft numbers, no more blue. The names in the 2×2 are a true 12 px. Devices per staff member counts as better lower. The figures add the heads without an IT workplace. The complexity factor takes 0.5 to 2 only, and the page says so.

entries.title: Maturity is saved at once
entries.detail: Enter maturity saves each choice the moment you make it, so nothing is lost when pactum closes. The spiders show all five dots, also for low scores. Chart text follows the folia Style Guide, and the explanation of the profiles stands apart.

entries.title: Big profiles, and the Average ID CxS
entries.detail: Each ISG's spiders are as big as the legend's, with the axis names. Their dashed line is the workbook's Average ID CxS; the Data page warns where it differs from the ID ISGs. Every bubble of the 2×2 has its name. The page says ID CxS.

entries.title: Departmental ISGs in the KPI comparison
entries.detail: The departmental ISGs now have their own figures, except D-EAPS, D-MATL and D-USYS, which stay hatched until their figures are in. Tickets per staff member is gone. Two KPIs are new: IT workplace cost per device, and devices per staff member with an IT workplace.

entries.title: About pactum is laid out as in folia
entries.detail: Settings › About pactum starts with the icon. The build facts stand in two columns. The About tab counts the changes you have not read. The foot of Settings names the build.

entries.title: Get the Mac app is now in About
entries.detail: Settings › About pactum now holds the download of the Mac app. In a browser the Mac app part is gone, as it held nothing else. In the Mac app, that part keeps its hotkey, its icon and opening at login.

entries.title: Settings as in folia, by the same parts
entries.detail: Settings now use the same parts as folia and specula. The left side and the title look as they do there; the rest stays where it was.

entries.title: A hotkey, and Settings › Mac app
entries.detail: ⌃⌥⌘P shows or hides pactum from any app, and you can record other keys. Settings › Mac app also holds where the icon shows, opening at login, and the download.

entries.title: Account, Docs and What's New in Settings
entries.detail: Settings has an Account part: who uses this Mac, and what pactum holds. About has a Read group. Docs waits for a Field Manual.

entries.title: Settings, and pactum in English
entries.detail: The gear at the top right opens Settings. About pactum says which build this is and where your data lives. The whole app now speaks English.

entries.title: Starts without the Input folder too
entries.detail: When the Input folder is missing, pactum makes it and shows an empty page. Before, the server stopped.

entries.title: An icon of its own
entries.detail: The spider: five spokes, the KPI profile of a group, in the colours of the app family.

entries.title: pactum 1
entries.detail: The KPI comparison of the IT service groups, from the SLA workbook and the eTHIS exports.
